Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor said about it: The Class III crowd of 0.5 pedestrians per square metre from the 4.4.1 Dynamic load cases (E35) gives 60 people from the crowd-count calculation (E40) on the 40 by 3 m deck, equivalent to 5.92 synchronized pedestrians from the equivalent-count calculation (E41) using the 10.8 times root damping times number rule from the same 4.4.1 Dynamic load cases (E35), times 280 N per pedestrian from the Vibration Serviceability Assessment of a Historic Suspension Footbridge (E32) giving about 1.66 kN resonant force, which gives 8.28 metres per second squared bare from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43) or 0.844 g almost a body weight and clearly outside everyday footbridge feel, falling to 0.668 metres per second squared with effective damping from the retrofitted-acceleration calculation (E44) and settling at 0.67 metres per second squared by 15 s in the crowd build-up simulation (E45).
